item.title: Install Extensions
item.description: This section explains how to install extensions. For information on how to access, configure, and use each extension, please refer to Extension User Guide. Prerequisites You should have the platform-admin role on the KubeSphere Enterprise platform. For more information, refer to the Users and Platform Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere Enterprise web console as a user with the platform-admin role. Click Extensions Center and search for the extension you want to install.

item.title: Upgrade Extensions
item.description: This section explains how to upgrade extensions. When a new version of an extension is available, you can upgrade the extension on the extension details page in the Extensions Center. 在 KubeSphere 企业版 v4.2.0 之前的版本中，在扩展组件安装时显式配置了镜像标签（image tag），而在 KubeSphere 企业版 v4.2.0 及之后的版本中，镜像标签会跟随扩展组件的版本，优先使用默认值，无需您手动配置。 因此，在升级扩展组件时，请务必确认镜像标签配置是否符合预期。新版本通常会使用新的镜像标签，如果您在配置中显式指定了旧的镜像标签，可能会导致升级后仍拉取旧版本镜像，无法获得最新功能或修复。 为确保升级顺利进行，请遵循以下建议： 检查并移除手动设置的镜像标签，或将其更新为新版本所需的镜像标签。 推荐使用默认配置，以自动获取与当前版本匹配的镜像标签。 各个扩展组件的镜像标签的配置路径，请参阅扩展中心各扩展组件详情页的升级说明。 Attention In versions prior to KubeSphere Enterprise v4.2.0, the image tag was explicitly configured during extension installation.

item.title: Uninstall Extensions
item.description: This section explains how to uninstall extensions. You can uninstall extensions on the extension details page in the Extensions Center. For extensions with cluster Agent configured, the cluster Agent will be uninstalled first, followed by the extension itself during the uninstallation process. Prerequisites You should have the platform-admin role on the KubeSphere Enterprise platform. For more information, please refer to Users and Platform Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere Enterprise web console with a user having the platform-admin role.
